headline: 1 in 4 major apps lack passkey login option: whynopasskeys.com
summary: A new website names and shames companies without passkey login. Instagram, Netflix, and Spotify are among those that don't offer passkeys.
details: Passkeys are considered the gold standard for securing accounts against hackers. They are more secure than passwords because they are generated by a user's device and tied to that phone or computer and the website they are created for.

A new website, whynopasskeys.com, names and shames companies that still don't give users the option to use passkeys to log in to their apps and services. The site's creator, Scott Helme, aims to push companies to enable passkeys and give users the chance to adopt them.

Major companies such as Apple, Google, and Microsoft offer passkeys to users, but some notable exceptions include Instagram, Netflix, and Spotify. Users can turn on passkeys on Instagram, but only if their account is tied to a Facebook account with a passkey enabled.
